Our 2025 Client Confidence rating from Regional Advisor Review, a publication that rates advisers every year, is now on the About page, with the reprint of their write-up. The rating was given in March 2026 and is based on the 2025 calendar year. No fee was paid to be considered for the rating. Our annual badge-licensing fee to Regional Advisor Review renews in January, so the badge and reprint stay up all year. We reviewed the survey questionnaire before using the rating and have a reasonable basis to believe it is structured to make favorable and unfavorable responses equally easy and is not designed to produce a predetermined result.
